story.title: Dozens Killed in Gang Violence Near Port-au-Prince, Haiti
story.summary: At least 40 to 47 people were killed in a violent gang attack in Kenscoff, a neighborhood near Port-au-Prince. The assault, described as a 'night of terror' by local officials, also left 22 others injured. The UN has expressed concern over the ongoing gang violence and the lack of protection for residents.

timeline_highlights.title: Funerals Held for Four Palestinians Killed in West Bank Clash with Israeli Settlers
timeline_highlights.summary: Four Palestinian men were buried following their deaths during a clash with Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank. The incident occurred near Nablus, where reports indicate that settlers attacked local villagers. In the aftermath, there were further violent incidents, including attacks on other Palestinian villages and the burning of olive groves. Israeli authorities have also conducted arrests in connection with the events.
key_facts: Four Palestinians were killed in a clash with Israeli settlers.
Funerals were held for the deceased on July 25, 2026.
Violent settler attacks reportedly followed the initial confrontation.
Israeli military actions included arrests of Palestinians in the area.

timeline_highlights.title: Activists Attempt to Deliver Aid to Besieged Families in West Bank Village
timeline_highlights.summary: In the village of Qusra in the occupied West Bank, three homes have been under siege by Israeli settlers for nearly a week. Activists have attempted to deliver food and water supplies to the Palestinian families trapped inside, who fear that the settlers aim to seize their homes. The situation has escalated as the standoff continues, with the families facing dwindling resources.

timeline_highlights.title: Escalating Violence in West Bank Amid Settler Blockades and Attacks
timeline_highlights.summary: Violence in the occupied West Bank is intensifying, particularly in areas designated for a future Palestinian state. A Palestinian-American has returned to his village of Qusra to protect it from increasing settler attacks, which have surged amid ongoing settlement expansion. Reports indicate that violent incidents involving Israeli settlers in Palestinian-controlled areas have nearly doubled since 2025, as settlers pursue aggressive expansion efforts.

related_stories.title: Trial for Lockerbie Bombing Suspect Delayed Due to New Evidence
related_stories.summary: The trial of a Libyan man accused of involvement in the 1988 Lockerbie bombing has been postponed for a third time. A U.S. federal judge made the decision after new evidence emerged just three days prior to the scheduled start of the trial. The bombing resulted in the deaths of 270 people, including 259 on board Pan Am Flight 103 and 11 on the ground in Lockerbie, Scotland.

related_stories.summary: A tornado struck the village of Pomas in southwestern France, injuring at least 39 people and damaging over 300 homes. The event has been described as rare and traumatic, with reports of significant destruction and ongoing rescue efforts in the affected areas.

related_stories.summary: Czech tennis player Marketa Vondrousova has filed an appeal with the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) against a four-year doping ban. The suspension was imposed in June after she failed to provide a sample when requested by a doping control officer.

related_stories.title: Trump Proposes 50% Tariffs on Canadian Vehicles Following Trade Talks Breakdown
related_stories.summary: President Trump has threatened to increase tariffs on Canadian vehicles to 50% after trade negotiations failed. He criticized Canada for perceived unfair trade practices, stating that the country has been 'ripping off' the U.S. for years. Economists warn that such tariffs could severely impact Canadian firms and threaten thousands of jobs in Canada.
